reason: Morning Star is an agent workflow engine and plugin for coordinating multi-agent software delivery through deterministic planning, dispatch, iteration, review, QA, and codebase-audit workflows.

summaries.zh: Morning Star 是一个面向软件交付的智能体工作流插件，用于通过计划、派发、迭代、评审、验收和代码库审计流程协调多智能体协作。
summaries.en: Morning Star is an agent workflow plugin for coordinating software delivery through planning, dispatch, iteration, review, QA, and codebase-audit workflows.

capabilities: Enforces workflow gates for planning, dispatch, iteration, review, and QA
Creates and updates plans, workflow snapshots, and project knowledge artifacts
Provides CLI-based installation, validation, and host adapters
Performs read-only codebase audits and produces prioritized plans
